checks.method_or_action: Fill the Add project form and click Create project
checks.expected_behavior: A private draft project is created; the creator is maintainer and an accepted contributor

checks.method_or_action: Enter krinapatell/immxrsive-platform and click Import, edit a value, save; later remove the repository link and save
checks.expected_behavior: Form is filled with editable suggestions; project stays valid with zero or several repository links

checks.method_or_action: Maintainer invites by GitHub username with a standard role; invitee accepts or declines under /student/projects
checks.setup: Invitee must have signed in and verified once
checks.expected_behavior: Invitee is not on /projects/{id} until accepted; after accepting, one project page lists both contributors with roles

checks.method_or_action: Contributor edits own statement and unticks 'Show this project on my profile'
checks.setup: Shared project with two accepted contributors
checks.expected_behavior: Only the contributor's own row changes; the maintainer has no control for it; hiding removes it from their profile but not from the project page

checks.method_or_action: Remove a contributor, then Restore; transfer maintenance
checks.setup: Shared project with two accepted contributors
checks.expected_behavior: Removal is a reversible soft delete; transfer keeps the same /projects/{id} URL

checks.method_or_action: Open the same project in two maintainer sessions, save in A, then save in B without reloading
checks.expected_behavior: B's save is refused with a conflict message showing A's newer version; nothing is overwritten
